courses.summary: 魯韋斯位於海岸並服務外銷市場；本課將原料彈性、港口儲運與大型換熱網路當成整體問題。本課依序分析原料成分彈性、產品分率變動、不同原料熱負荷、海運品質分槽、產品交接品質帳，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: Ruwais is a coastal export-oriented refinery; the case combines feed flexibility, port storage and heat-network interactions. The course analyses flexibility in feed composition, changes in product fractions, heat duty for different feeds, marine-export grade segregation, product handover quality balance, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
